lineage.description: Spatial inventory of IDP camps, refugee sites, and host villages compiled from direct field observations and multi-sectoral assessments conducted by UNHCR, IOM, and NGO partners from 2016 onwards. Data includes site locations (coordinates), administrative classifications, verification dates, and organizational codes for cross-referencing with humanitarian databases.
